text:
maria: Hey — spotted something weird in the console: tenant A has an SLO threshold flagged as violated but the notify column shows "suppressed" and no contact got paged. Is sampling/quota logic applied after we mark the threshold? :thinking:
kevin: hmm. can you paste the SLO id + the notify policy? might be a per-tenant override or the sample_rate got applied later in the pipeline
maria: SLO id `slo:payment-latency:prod:tenantA` and policy id `np:window-90m:v2`. Screenshot: https://example.com/ss/slo-1798.png
kevin: thanks. looks like the notify_policy has a sample_rate=0.02 and tenantA has a small traffic weight (0.1). That gives an effective notify prob of 0.2% — might be below our notify-floor and so we mark suppressed. We should make that visible in the console though
maria: here's the exact policy blob we use (from DB):
```
{"policy_id":"np:window-90m:v2","fanout":["pd"],"sample_rate":0.02,"quiet_window":600}
```
alex: Yea — UX mismatch: console shows threshold state (violated) and a separate notify column that says suppressed. Folks assume suppressed means we won't page because of the routing decision, but it's actually because the effective sample/probability = 0.2% which is lower than the tenant notify-floor. We should surface the computed effective rate + reason
olivia: rollout UX note — when we flip notify sampling or tenant weights we usually do canary for 1% of tenants. If the console showed an "effective notify" badge and a hover with "why suppressed" (sample vs floor vs quota) it'd help PMs & SREs decide to increase canary size :eyes:
kevin: API side is trivial to add — return an extra field in the SLO evaluation response: `effective_notify_probability` and `notify_reason` (enum: floor, quota, sample, disabled). example response snippet: 
```
{ "slo_id":"...", "violated":true, "effective_notify_probability":"0.002", "notify_reason":"sample" }
```
deploy-bot: config-update: notify-policy np:window-90m:v2 flagged for audit by kevin at 2024-11-03T16:12:01Z :robot_face:
olivia: also pls ensure telemetry emits the pre- and post-sample counters. right now we only log "slo_violation_count" which hides how many were dropped due to sampling. need to increment `slo_notify_attempts` and `slo_notify_sent` metrics
maria: good call. also need to check quotas — if tenant exhausted notify_quota we currently short-circuit earlier and console just shows "muted by quota" which is okay but we should still show the quota consumption rate in the SLO details pane
kevin: implementation plan: add fields to /v1/slo/eval, backfill telemetry keys, and add small UI badge `notify: 0.2% (sample)` in the per-SLO row. will throw a tiny API schema PR and a UI mock. if no objections I'll do it tomorrow
alex: I can take the UI mock + a11y hover text. also suggest a small color hint: orange for low-prob, red for 0% (explicitly disabled) :thumbsup:
maria: thanks team — sync in 15 if anyone's around. tagging @kevin @olivia for visibility. :raised_hands:
